optional_arguments.scope_prefix: exact clause reference or dot-delimited descendants

query_modes.exact_phrase: all parsed tokens in their original order and adjacency
query_modes.any_terms: at least one parsed token is required
query_modes.natural_language: fixed stopword filtering plus Porter stemming; strict AND is attempted first and one disclosed OR relaxation occurs only when strict authorized results are empty

packet_fields.query_interpretation: mode, normalized query, parsed terms, and for natural_language the effective and ignored terms, tokenizer, ranker, attempted strategies, and selected strategy

result_fields.matched_snippet: FTS5 snippet from the indexed record text
result_fields.heading_ancestry: optional structural parent records in root-to-parent order; omitted when absent

optional_arguments.cursor: signed principal, prefix, visibility, and position-bound continuation

optional_arguments.clause_reference: unique record reference within the pinned package
optional_arguments.record_id: canonical record identity within the pinned package

invariants: query operations do not fetch or activate content
document inventory and resolve near-match candidates contain only packages actively authorized for the bound principal
document inventory continuations bind operation, normalized prefix, principal, visibility snapshot, position, count, and expiry
resolve_document reports representation on success and in ambiguity candidates; exact package pins remain authoritative
get_clause selectors are directly replayable from search results and cannot silently resolve a mismatched clause-reference and record-ID pair
package rights claims do not grant operational access
required evidence is atomic under byte budgets
continuations bind package, scope, principal, policy, and expiry
edition diffs do not infer moves from similarity
compact and concise evidence profiles preserve exact text and canonical record IDs while deduplicating packet-local source and derivation dictionaries
omitting response_profile preserves the existing detailed JSON representation
search filters are exact local constraints and never relax or invoke network or model fallback
search bounds raw input and parsed terms before FTS execution
search exact modes quote tokens and preserve their declared phrase, all-terms, or any-terms semantics
natural_language search uses a separate Porter index and discloses its single bounded relaxation
search ranking uses only row-local values and is unaffected by unauthorized rows
search returns a source citation, an FTS5 snippet from the exact indexed record text, and structural heading ancestry when parent records exist
list_documents and resolve_document remain the explicit identifier discovery and resolution path
search remains lexical and never silently combines exact document resolution with record search
